entries.name: Archeologist
entries.heading: Archeologist (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): +2 bullwhip, +0 leather jacket, +0 fedora, 3 food rations, pick-axe, tinning kit, touchstone, sack.
Extra items: 1 in 10 chance: tin opener; otherwise 1 in 4 chance: oil lamp; otherwise 1 in 5 chance: magic marker.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).
Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 1 automatic searching, XL 5 stealth, XL 10 speed.

entries.name: Barbarian
entries.heading: Barbarian (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): .
Extra items: 50% chance: +0 two-handed sword, +0 axe, +0 ring mail, food ration; otherwise: +0 battle-axe, +0 short sword, +0 ring mail, food ration; 1 in 6 chance: oil lamp.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).
Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 1 poison resistance, XL 7 speed, XL 15 stealth.

entries.name: Caveman
entries.heading: Caveman (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): +1 club, +2 sling, 10-20 flints, 3 rocks, +0 leather armor.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).
Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 7 speed, XL 15 warning.

entries.name: Healer
entries.heading: Healer (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): +0 scalpel, +1 leather gloves, stethoscope, 4 potions of healing, 4 potions of extra healing, wand of sleep, blessed spellbook of healing, blessed spellbook of extra healing, blessed spellbook of stone to flesh, 5 apples.
Extra items: 1 in 25 chance: oil lamp.
Also: gold: 1001-2000.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).
Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 1 poison resistance, XL 15 warning.

entries.name: Knight
entries.heading: Knight (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): +1 long sword, +1 lance, +1 ring mail, +0 helmet, +0 small shield, +0 leather gloves, 10 apples, 10 carrots.
Also: intrinsic jumping.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).
Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 7 speed.

entries.name: Monk
entries.heading: Monk (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): +2 leather gloves, +1 robe, 1 random scroll, 3 potions of healing, 3 food rations, 5 apples, 5 oranges, 3 fortune cookies, one of: blessed spellbook of healing / blessed spellbook of protection / blessed spellbook of confuse monster.
Extra items: 1 in 4 chance: magic marker; otherwise 1 in 10 chance: oil lamp.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).

Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 1 speed, XL 1 sleep resistance, XL 1 see invisible, XL 3 poison resistance, XL 5 stealth, XL 7 warning, XL 9 automatic searching, XL 11 fire resistance, XL 13 cold resistance, XL 15 shock resistance, XL 17 teleport control.

entries.name: Priest
entries.heading: Priest (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): blessed +1 mace, +0 robe, +0 small shield, 4 blessed potions of water, clove of garlic, sprig of wolfsbane, 2 random spellbooks.
Extra items: 1 in 5 chance: magic marker; otherwise 1 in 10 chance: oil lamp.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).
Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 15 warning, XL 20 fire resistance.

entries.name: Ranger
entries.heading: Ranger (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): +1 dagger, +1 bow, 50-59 +2 arrows, 30-39 +0 arrows, +2 cloak of displacement, 4 cram rations.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).
Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 1 automatic searching, XL 7 stealth, XL 15 see invisible.

entries.name: Rogue
entries.heading: Rogue (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): +0 short sword, 6-15 +0 daggers, +1 leather armor, potion of sickness, lock pick, sack.
Extra items: 1 in 5 chance: blindfold.
Also: no gold.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).
Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 1 stealth, XL 10 automatic searching.

Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).

entries.name: Tourist
entries.heading: Tourist (role)
lines: Starting inventory (src/u_init.c): 21-40 +2 darts, 10 random food items, 2 potions of extra healing, 4 scrolls of magic mapping, +0 Hawaiian shirt, expensive camera, credit card.
Extra items: 1 in 25 chance: tin opener; otherwise 1 in 25 chance: leash; otherwise 1 in 25 chance: towel; otherwise 1 in 20 chance: magic marker.
Also: gold: 1-1000.
Race substitutions apply (e.g. elves get elven versions of daggers, spears and bows; orcs orcish ones; dwarves dwarvish spears and helmets).
Intrinsics by experience level (src/attrib.c): XL 10 automatic searching, XL 20 poison resistance.

entries.name: price identification
entries.heading: price identification (shop prices)
lines: Gist: shop prices follow from an item's base price, so they narrow down what an unidentified item can be (to a group of same-priced types, rarely a single one). How to do it is spoiler-level.
spoiler: BUYING (src/shk.c get_cost()): the base price; times 4/3 if this unidentified object is one of the 1 in 4 (by its object id) that carry a surcharge; times 4/3 when wearing a dunce cap, as a Tourist below experience level 15, or with a visible Hawaiian shirt; then by Charisma: 5 or less x2, 6-7 x3/2, 8-10 x4/3, 11-15 x1, 16-17 x3/4, 18 x2/3, 19+ x1/2 (rounded). An angry shopkeeper adds 1/3.
